fact: On 21 July 2026 the BCEAO announced it was finalising agreements for a six-month PAPSS pilot with more than 80 UEMOA commercial banks, with the BCEAO observing only, and PI-SPI had 80 connected participants at 24 June 2026.
title: BCEAO–PAPSS : plus de 80 banques mobilisées pour réduire la dépendance de l'UEMOA aux circuits de paiement extérieurs
